classes.discarded: priceFilter (every field), upperFundingRate, lowerFundingRate, preListingInfo contents, every other field
classes.name: catalog_linear
classes.note: rows launched from 2025-10-01 are dropped before any other field is read
classes.params: category=linear, status in (Trading, Delivering, Closed), limit=1000, cursor
classes.parsed: symbol, baseCoin, contractType, settleCoin, status, launchTime, deliveryTime, fundingInterval, isPreListing (presence), lotSizeFilter.minNotionalValue, lotSizeFilter.qtyStep, lotSizeFilter.minOrderQty, leverageFilter.maxLeverage

classes.discarded: the page itself, every directory with no date or a date from the cut or a catalog symbol, and any count of directories
classes.name: archive_root
classes.note: reduced in memory against the whole catalog; an unknown date is not kept; max 2 because an interrupted phase 0 repeats once
classes.parsed: directory names ending USDT that are absent from the whole catalog and whose modification date is inside the window; for them the date, compared only with the window

classes.discarded: file names and dates from 2025-10-01 (dropped uncounted), sizes, every other byte
classes.name: archive_listing
classes.params: one request per in-window launch and one per archive-only candidate
classes.parsed: file names matching SYMBOL + YYYY-MM-DD + .csv.gz and their dates, only dates before 2025-10-01 are kept

classes.discarded: everything else (a HEAD has no body)
classes.name: first_file_head
classes.note: proves the first file exists and gives its size for the preflight of D2
classes.params: none; only launches whose first listed day is within one day of launchTime

classes.discarded: columns 2 and later of every row (side, size, price, ids, notionals), unparsed; the file is never stored
classes.name: first_file
classes.note: runs only if the summed Content-Length of D2h is at most the class byte cap
classes.params: none; the whole first daily file, streamed and gunzipped in memory
classes.parsed: column 1 only (the trade timestamp): minimum, maximum, first, last, row count

classes.discarded: open, high, low, close, volume, turnover, unparsed
classes.name: entry_trade_bar
classes.note: one V1 entry bar per entry candidate; decides entry_unavailable
classes.params: category=linear, symbol, interval=1, start=E, end=E, limit=1
classes.parsed: column 1 only (the bar start time), existence

classes.name: mark_hourly
classes.note: hourly mark-price series over days 3 to 21, one page per launch
classes.params: category=linear, symbol, interval=60, start=T0+3d, end=min(T0+21d, cut), limit=1000
classes.parsed: column 1 only (the bar start time): count, oldest, newest and the runs of missing hours

classes.discarded: open, high, low, close, volume, turnover, unparsed
classes.name: trade_hourly
classes.note: hourly trade-bar series over days 3 to 21, one page per launch
classes.params: category=linear, symbol, interval=60, start=T0+3d, end=min(T0+21d, cut), limit=1000
classes.parsed: column 1 only (the bar start time): count, oldest, newest and the runs of missing hours

classes.name: funding_history
classes.note: paged by the HYP-036 rule; at most four pages per launch
classes.params: category=linear, symbol, startTime=T0+3d, endTime paged backwards, limit=200
classes.parsed: fundingRateTimestamp only: per page the row count, oldest, newest and the largest gap between consecutive timestamps

windows.note: nothing dated from the cut is read, recorded or counted
